object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Give an object a table and show its row in the grid; open the table editor on it. Expected: the description cell carries the table; the row is taller than without the table, by exactly the description's height plus the table's height plus the cell padding; the table editor starts below the description, and its caption is the object's description.
